capabilities: Export Bases views as a single HTML file or a multi-file folder
Preserve views, properties, filters, grouping, sorting, tags and badges
Provide live search, filter toggles, sorting and view switching in the exported page
Open note detail modals with properties and rendered Markdown
Customize theme, page width, fonts and custom CSS
disambiguation: Not a general Markdown-to-HTML converter; it only exports Bases views.
extras: Only Cards and Table views are supported; custom summary formulas are exported as static values and do not recalculate when filters change. Export settings are saved in the plugin's data.json and can be reset in settings.
problem: Bases views only exist inside Obsidian, so there is no way to share them as browsable pages on the web.
summary: Exporter that turns Obsidian Bases views into standalone, interactive HTML pages for static hosting.
